reviewContext: This is the detent repository itself, not a project detent is installed in, so some paths above do not apply here. The constitution is constitution/constitution.md, not a block in CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md: read it. The spec format is skills/design-spec/spec-format.md, not under .agents/skills/ or .claude/skills/: read it when reviewing a spec. There is no root spec.md yet: the design specs under docs/specs/ describe the product's behaviour. These substitutes are known, so do not report the original paths as missing. In this repo the skills say the scoped form of the command, but here run `npx detent` or `node dist/cli.js`, because the scoped package is not necessarily published yet.
